keep_it_filter_sentence: use keep_it to filter sentences by length, punctuation ratio, number ratio, space ratio, emoji ratio, and repeated character limits
count_char_type_count_punctuation: use count_char_type with a Counter and punctuation string to count total punctuation characters in text
count_char_type_count_numbers: use count_char_type with a Counter and digit string to count total numeric characters in text
count_emoji_count_emojis: use count_emoji with a Counter to count total emoji characters in a sentence
test_keep_it_run_tests: run test_keep_it to verify the sentence filtering logic against various edge cases
